response.sql: WITH joined AS (SELECT r.circuitId, c.country, r.round FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId), circuit_avg AS (SELECT circuitId, country, AVG(round) AS circuit_avg_round FROM joined GROUP BY circuitId, country), country_base AS (SELECT country, AVG(round) AS country_avg_round FROM joined GROUP BY country) SELECT ca.circuitId, ca.country, ca.circuit_avg_round, ca.circuit_avg_round - cb.country_avg_round AS diff_from_country_baseline FROM circuit_avg ca JOIN country_base cb ON cb.country IS ca.country ORDER BY diff_from_country_baseline DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Only races whose circuitId exists in circuits are included (inner join), as the request specifies.
The country baseline is the plain average of races.round over all included races in that country, so each race counts once and circuits with more races weigh more, as requested.
Each circuitId maps to exactly one country in circuits, so grouping by circuitId and country yields one row per circuit.
A NULL country is treated as its own group and joined with IS, so circuits without a country are kept rather than dropped.
NULL round values are ignored by AVG. A circuit or country with no non-null rounds gets a NULL average or difference, which sorts last via NULLS LAST.
The database is SQLite (the schema uses SQLite syntax), so NULLS LAST requires SQLite 3.30 or later.
